verdict.rationale: First-party Cowork docs describe scheduled tasks that run automatically on a recurring basis or on demand, delivering finished reports, briefings and summaries on your schedule. Users can also describe an outcome, step away and return to finished multi-step work, which directly matches background autonomous automation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled tasks run reliably unattended, and documentation of trigger types beyond schedules and of background-execution constraints (e.g., whether the desktop app must stay running).
